description: The object written in `<meta name="ypy-config" content='...'>` and the keys of `ypy.config`.

allowEmptySwapAfterOOB.description: Runs the main swap when the response held only out-of-band elements. `<ypy-partial>` content always prevents the main swap.
allowEmptySwapAfterOOB.markdownDescription: Runs the main swap when the response held only out-of-band elements. `<ypy-partial>` content always prevents the main swap.

announce.description: Announcements through the managed live region. Unset means on; `false` turns them off; an object sets the messages.
announce.markdownDescription: Announcements through the managed live region. Unset means on; `false` turns them off; an object sets the messages.

clearAfter.description: Milliseconds before the live region is emptied.
clearAfter.markdownDescription: Milliseconds before the live region is emptied.

messages.description: Texts for the live region. The core carries none: a message that is not set says nothing.
messages.markdownDescription: Texts for the live region. The core carries none: a message that is not set says nothing.

answerFailed.description: Said, assertive, when a model answer failed. Requires the `ypy-model` extension.
answerFailed.markdownDescription: Said, assertive, when a model answer failed. Requires the `ypy-model` extension.

answerReady.description: Said when a model answer is finished (also the text of the `ypy-announce` attribute of its container). Requires the `ypy-model` extension.
answerReady.markdownDescription: Said when a model answer is finished (also the text of the `ypy-announce` attribute of its container). Requires the `ypy-model` extension.

answerStart.description: Said when a model answer starts. Requires the `ypy-model` extension.
answerStart.markdownDescription: Said when a model answer starts. Requires the `ypy-model` extension.

answerStopped.description: Said, assertive, when a model answer was stopped. Requires the `ypy-model` extension.
answerStopped.markdownDescription: Said, assertive, when a model answer was stopped. Requires the `ypy-model` extension.

done.description: Said when a request ends and its response was swapped.
done.markdownDescription: Said when a request ends and its response was swapped.

error.description: Said when a request failed for any other reason.
error.markdownDescription: Said when a request failed for any other reason.

offline.description: Said when a request failed for lack of a connection.
offline.markdownDescription: Said when a request failed for lack of a connection.

stream.description: `blocks` says the text of each closed block of a model answer, shortened, at most once every 3 seconds. Unset: only the start and the end of the answer are said. Requires the `ypy-model` extension.
stream.markdownDescription: `blocks` says the text of each closed block of a model answer, shortened, at most once every 3 seconds. Unset: only the start and the end of the answer are said. Requires the `ypy-model` extension.

ariaBusy.description: Marks the target `aria-busy="true"` while a request runs. Unset means on.
ariaBusy.markdownDescription: Marks the target `aria-busy="true"` while a request runs. Unset means on.

autofocus.description: Focuses the `[autofocus]` element of swapped content. Off by default; an `[autofocus]` element with `ypy-focus` asks for it by itself.
autofocus.markdownDescription: Focuses the `[autofocus]` element of swapped content. Off by default; an `[autofocus]` element with `ypy-focus` asks for it by itself.

boostBrowserIndicator.description: Show the browser indicator for every boosted element, without writing `ypy-browser-indicator` on each one. Requires the `ypy-browser-indicator` extension.
boostBrowserIndicator.markdownDescription: Show the browser indicator for every boosted element, without writing `ypy-browser-indicator` on each one. Requires the `ypy-browser-indicator` extension.

cache.description: Defaults for `ypy-cache`; the attribute overrides them per element. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.
cache.markdownDescription: Defaults for `ypy-cache`; the attribute overrides them per element. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.

all.description: Cache every GET of the page, not only the elements with `ypy-cache`. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.
all.markdownDescription: Cache every GET of the page, not only the elements with `ypy-cache`. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.

bytes.description: Most characters of response text held. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.
bytes.markdownDescription: Most characters of response text held. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.

fresh.description: A copy younger than this is shown without asking the server. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.
fresh.markdownDescription: A copy younger than this is shown without asking the server. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.

offline.description: Keep copies in `sessionStorage` and show them when the network fails. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.
offline.markdownDescription: Keep copies in `sessionStorage` and show them when the network fails. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.

private.description: Also keep responses marked `Cache-Control: private`. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.
private.markdownDescription: Also keep responses marked `Cache-Control: private`. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.

size.description: Most copies held. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.
size.markdownDescription: Most copies held. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.

ttl.description: A copy older than this is not shown, only revalidated. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.
ttl.markdownDescription: A copy older than this is not shown, only revalidated. Requires the `ypy-cache` extension.

callbacks.description: What author code (`ypy-on`, `js:` values, `[filter]` triggers) may do: `none` never compiles code, `nonce` runs it only through `ypy-csp`, `all` always runs it. Unset means `none`.
callbacks.markdownDescription: What author code (`ypy-on`, `js:` values, `[filter]` triggers) may do: `none` never compiles code, `nonce` runs it only through `ypy-csp`, `all` always runs it. Unset means `none`.

classes.description: State classes, one entry per state, each a space separated list. Set an entry to replace it.
classes.markdownDescription: State classes, one entry per state, each a space separated list. Set an entry to replace it.

added.description: Applied to freshly swapped content until it settles.
added.markdownDescription: Applied to freshly swapped content until it settles.

dirty.description: Class added to a signals scope element while it holds unsaved changes. Set it to a space separated list to replace the default. Requires the `ypy-signals` extension.
dirty.markdownDescription: Class added to a signals scope element while it holds unsaved changes. Set it to a space separated list to replace the default. Requires the `ypy-signals` extension.

error.description: Added to the error target after a response of 400 or more was swapped. There is no default class: `data-ypy-state="error"` is enough to style it.
error.markdownDescription: Added to the error target after a response of 400 or more was swapped. There is no default class: `data-ypy-state="error"` is enough to style it.

indicator.description: Applied to elements that show only during a request.
indicator.markdownDescription: Applied to elements that show only during a request.

offline.description: Applied to `<html>` while the browser reports no connection.
offline.markdownDescription: Applied to `<html>` while the browser reports no connection.

request.description: Applied to the indicators of the request while it runs (the requesting element, unless `ypy-indicator` names others). `data-ypy-state="request"` is set with it.
request.markdownDescription: Applied to the indicators of the request while it runs (the requesting element, unless `ypy-indicator` names others). `data-ypy-state="request"` is set with it.

settling.description: Applied to the swap target while it settles.
settling.markdownDescription: Applied to the swap target while it settles.

swapping.description: Applied to the swap target between the start of the swap and the swap itself.
swapping.markdownDescription: Applied to the swap target between the start of the swap and the swap itself.

commands.description: Settings of the `YPY-Commands` header. Requires the `ypy-commands` extension.
commands.markdownDescription: Settings of the `YPY-Commands` header. Requires the `ypy-commands` extension.

max.description: Most commands a `YPY-Commands` list may hold; a longer list is ignored as a whole. Requires the `ypy-commands` extension.
max.markdownDescription: Most commands a `YPY-Commands` list may hold; a longer list is ignored as a whole. Requires the `ypy-commands` extension.

compositionTimeout.description: How long, in milliseconds, a swap waits for the end of an IME composition in a field its target contains. The swap goes on after that time even when the composition is still open. Requires the `ypy-preserve` extension.
compositionTimeout.markdownDescription: How long, in milliseconds, a swap waits for the end of an IME composition in a field its target contains. The swap goes on after that time even when the composition is still open. Requires the `ypy-preserve` extension.

dedupe.description: Settings of the sharing of identical GET requests. Requires the `ypy-dedupe` extension.
dedupe.markdownDescription: Settings of the sharing of identical GET requests. Requires the `ypy-dedupe` extension.

ignore.description: Names of the request headers that do not make two requests different (compared without regard to case). Every other header must be equal for the requests to be shared. Requires the `ypy-dedupe` extension.
ignore.markdownDescription: Names of the request headers that do not make two requests different (compared without regard to case). Every other header must be equal for the requests to be shared. Requires the `ypy-dedupe` extension.

defaultFocusScroll.description: Scrolls the focused element into view after each swap.
defaultFocusScroll.markdownDescription: Scrolls the focused element into view after each swap.

defaultSettleDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds between the swap and the settle phases.
defaultSettleDelay.markdownDescription: Delay in milliseconds between the swap and the settle phases.

defaultSwap.description: The swap style used when `ypy-swap` is not set: `innerMorph`.
defaultSwap.markdownDescription: The swap style used when `ypy-swap` is not set: `innerMorph`.

dev.description: Options of the development extension `ypy-dev`; `false` turns it off. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.
dev.markdownDescription: Options of the development extension `ypy-dev`; `false` turns it off. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.

docs.description: Base URL of the guide pages that the legacy warnings link to. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.
docs.markdownDescription: Base URL of the guide pages that the legacy warnings link to. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.

latency.description: Simulated latency in milliseconds, or `[min, max]` (the JSON form of the tag). Off by default. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.
latency.markdownDescription: Simulated latency in milliseconds, or `[min, max]` (the JSON form of the tag). Off by default. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.

lint.description: `false` turns the markup and legacy warnings off. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.
lint.markdownDescription: `false` turns the markup and legacy warnings off. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.

log.description: `false` keeps the console quiet; messages are still recorded and fired as `ypy:dev:message`. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.
log.markdownDescription: `false` keeps the console quiet; messages are still recorded and fired as `ypy:dev:message`. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.

offline.description: Start with the simulated offline state on. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.
offline.markdownDescription: Start with the simulated offline state on. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.

overlay.description: Show a panel with the status, the URL, the start of the response and the element when a request fails; Esc closes it. On by default only on a development host (`localhost`, `127.*`, `[::1]`, `*.local`, `*.test`, `*.localhost`). Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.
overlay.markdownDescription: Show a panel with the status, the URL, the start of the response and the element when a request fails; Esc closes it. On by default only on a development host (`localhost`, `127.*`, `[::1]`, `*.local`, `*.test`, `*.localhost`). Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.

reload.description: Reload the page when a template changes: `true` listens on `/__ypy/reload`, a string is the URL of the Server-Sent Events endpoint. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.
reload.markdownDescription: Reload the page when a template changes: `true` listens on `/__ypy/reload`, a string is the URL of the Server-Sent Events endpoint. Requires the `ypy-dev` extension.

extensions.description: Comma separated list of the extensions allowed to register. Empty allows all.
extensions.markdownDescription: Comma separated list of the extensions allowed to register. Empty allows all.

history.description: Controls history management: `true` pushes URLs and restores by request, `false` turns history off, `"reload"` pushes URLs and reloads the page on back and forward.
history.markdownDescription: Controls history management: `true` pushes URLs and restores by request, `false` turns history off, `"reload"` pushes URLs and reloads the page on back and forward.

historyCache.description: Options of the history cache extension. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.
historyCache.markdownDescription: Options of the history cache extension. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.

disable.description: Turn the cache off without unloading the extension. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.
disable.markdownDescription: Turn the cache off without unloading the extension. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.

encrypt.description: Seal the pages kept in `sessionStorage` with WebCrypto (AES-GCM, a key made for the session). `true` keeps the key in `sessionStorage`, so the pages survive a reload; `"memory"` keeps it in memory only, so after a reload the old pages are not readable. Without WebCrypto nothing is stored. `ypy.history.clear()` replaces the key. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.
encrypt.markdownDescription: Seal the pages kept in `sessionStorage` with WebCrypto (AES-GCM, a key made for the session). `true` keeps the key in `sessionStorage`, so the pages survive a reload; `"memory"` keeps it in memory only, so after a reload the old pages are not readable. Without WebCrypto nothing is stored. `ypy.history.clear()` replaces the key. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.

refreshOnMiss.description: Reload the page on back or forward when it is not in the cache. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.
refreshOnMiss.markdownDescription: Reload the page on back or forward when it is not in the cache. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.

size.description: How many pages are kept in `sessionStorage`; the oldest is dropped first. `0` turns saving off. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.
size.markdownDescription: How many pages are kept in `sessionStorage`; the oldest is dropped first. `0` turns saving off. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.

swapStyle.description: Swap style used to put the cached content back. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.
swapStyle.markdownDescription: Swap style used to put the cached content back. Requires the `ypy-history-cache` extension.

historyRestore.description: Options of the request that restores a page from history.
historyRestore.markdownDescription: Options of the request that restores a page from history.

cache.description: The fetch `cache` mode of the request that restores a page on back and forward. The default is `no-cache`.
cache.markdownDescription: The fetch `cache` mode of the request that restores a page on back and forward. The default is `no-cache`.

fragment.description: Reloads the page when a restore gets something that is not a whole page, instead of swapping the fragment. On by default.
fragment.markdownDescription: Reloads the page when a restore gets something that is not a whole page, instead of swapping the fragment. On by default.

includeIndicatorCSS.description: Includes the built-in CSS of the indicator class.
includeIndicatorCSS.markdownDescription: Includes the built-in CSS of the indicator class.

inert.description: Makes the target of every request `inert` while it runs. `ypy-inert` overrides it per element. Requires the `ypy-disable` extension.
inert.markdownDescription: Makes the target of every request `inert` while it runs. `ypy-inert` overrides it per element. Requires the `ypy-disable` extension.

inlineScriptNonce.description: The `nonce` of the inline `<script>` elements YPY creates, for a strict CSP.
inlineScriptNonce.markdownDescription: The `nonce` of the inline `<script>` elements YPY creates, for a strict CSP.

inspector.description: Options of the inspector panel `ypy-inspector`; `false` leaves the page untouched. Requires the `ypy-inspector` extension.
inspector.markdownDescription: Options of the inspector panel `ypy-inspector`; `false` leaves the page untouched. Requires the `ypy-inspector` extension.

key.description: The shortcut that opens and closes the panel: modifiers (`Alt`, `Shift`, `Ctrl`, `Meta`) and a letter, joined with `+`. Requires the `ypy-inspector` extension.
key.markdownDescription: The shortcut that opens and closes the panel: modifiers (`Alt`, `Shift`, `Ctrl`, `Meta`) and a letter, joined with `+`. Requires the `ypy-inspector` extension.

max.description: Rows kept in each list; the oldest go first. Requires the `ypy-inspector` extension.
max.markdownDescription: Rows kept in each list; the oldest go first. Requires the `ypy-inspector` extension.

open.description: Show the panel at start. Requires the `ypy-inspector` extension.
open.markdownDescription: Show the panel at start. Requires the `ypy-inspector` extension.

layers.description: Defaults of the ypy-layers extension. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.
layers.markdownDescription: Defaults of the ypy-layers extension. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.

classes.description: Classes added to the dialog of each kind (`modal`, `drawer`, `popup`), for example Tailwind utilities, and `opener`, the class a popup puts on its opener for anchoring. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.
classes.markdownDescription: Classes added to the dialog of each kind (`modal`, `drawer`, `popup`), for example Tailwind utilities, and `opener`, the class a popup puts on its opener for anchoring. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.

escape.description: Whether Esc dismisses a layer. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.
escape.markdownDescription: Whether Esc dismisses a layer. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.

history.description: Whether layers show their URL in the address bar by default. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.
history.markdownDescription: Whether layers show their URL in the address bar by default. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.

outside.description: Whether a click outside a layer dismisses it. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.
outside.markdownDescription: Whether a click outside a layer dismisses it. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.

scrollLock.description: `false` leaves the page scrolling behind a modal or a drawer. The lock is the attribute `data-ypy-layer-lock` on `<html>`. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.
scrollLock.markdownDescription: `false` leaves the page scrolling behind a modal or a drawer. The lock is the attribute `data-ypy-layer-lock` on `<html>`. Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.

style.description: `false` does not add the optional default stylesheet (zero specificity, `--ypy-layer-*` variables). Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.
style.markdownDescription: `false` does not add the optional default stylesheet (zero specificity, `--ypy-layer-*` variables). Requires the `ypy-layers` extension.

lazy.description: Settings of lazy regions. Requires the `ypy-lazy` extension.
lazy.markdownDescription: Settings of lazy regions. Requires the `ypy-lazy` extension.

margin.description: How far outside the window a region is loaded, as a CSS margin. Requires the `ypy-lazy` extension.
margin.markdownDescription: How far outside the window a region is loaded, as a CSS margin. Requires the `ypy-lazy` extension.

window.description: How long a region of a group waits for the others to come into view before the group is requested, in milliseconds or as a time such as `"50ms"`. Requires the `ypy-lazy` extension.
window.markdownDescription: How long a region of a group waits for the others to come into view before the group is requested, in milliseconds or as a time such as `"50ms"`. Requires the `ypy-lazy` extension.

live.description: Settings of the ypy-live extension. Requires the `ypy-live` extension.
live.markdownDescription: Settings of the ypy-live extension. Requires the `ypy-live` extension.

bindPrefix.description: Short binding prefix: `":"` makes `:text` work, `"ypy:"` makes `ypy:text` work, and `""` or `false` turns the short form off. When Alpine.js is detected the short form is off unless this is set. Requires the `ypy-live` extension.
bindPrefix.markdownDescription: Short binding prefix: `":"` makes `:text` work, `"ypy:"` makes `ypy:text` work, and `""` or `false` turns the short form off. When Alpine.js is detected the short form is off unless this is set. Requires the `ypy-live` extension.

inputDebounce.description: Debounces `input` events before expressions are re-evaluated, in ms or as an interval string. Requires the `ypy-live` extension.
inputDebounce.markdownDescription: Debounces `input` events before expressions are re-evaluated, in ms or as an interval string. Requires the `ypy-live` extension.

useDollar.description: Adds `$()` as an alias of `q()` in `ypy-live`, `:attr`, `ypy-on`, `js:` attributes and `ypy-trigger` filters. Requires the `ypy-live` extension.
useDollar.markdownDescription: Adds `$()` as an alias of `q()` in `ypy-live`, `:attr`, `ypy-on`, `js:` attributes and `ypy-trigger` filters. Requires the `ypy-live` extension.

locked.description: Set `true` in the `ypy-config` meta tag to freeze `mode`, `callbacks`, `extensions`, `nonce`, `inlineScriptNonce`, `scripts` and `ypy.config` itself when the extension starts. Later assignments are ignored with a console warning. `ypy.config.lock()` does the same at run time. It cannot be undone. Requires the `ypy-lock` extension.
locked.markdownDescription: Set `true` in the `ypy-config` meta tag to freeze `mode`, `callbacks`, `extensions`, `nonce`, `inlineScriptNonce`, `scripts` and `ypy.config` itself when the extension starts. Later assignments are ignored with a console warning. `ypy.config.lock()` does the same at run time. It cannot be undone. Requires the `ypy-lock` extension.

logAll.description: Logs every YPY event to the console.
logAll.markdownDescription: Logs every YPY event to the console.

metaCharacter.description: Replaces `:` in attribute modifiers, for templating engines that treat `:` specially.
metaCharacter.markdownDescription: Replaces `:` in attribute modifiers, for templating engines that treat `:` specially.

mode.description: The fetch `mode` of every YPY request. Elements cannot override it.
mode.markdownDescription: The fetch `mode` of every YPY request. Elements cannot override it.

morphIgnore.description: Attribute name prefixes a morph leaves alone.
morphIgnore.markdownDescription: Attribute name prefixes a morph leaves alone.

morphScanLimit.description: How many siblings a morph scans when it matches nodes.
morphScanLimit.markdownDescription: How many siblings a morph scans when it matches nodes.

morphSkip.description: Selector of the elements a morph skips entirely.
morphSkip.markdownDescription: Selector of the elements a morph skips entirely.

morphSkipChildren.description: Selector of the elements whose children a morph freezes. Their attributes still update.
morphSkipChildren.markdownDescription: Selector of the elements whose children a morph freezes. Their attributes still update.

morphThirdParty.description: Selector of the elements a script other than YPY owns, besides every custom element. A morph keeps the children of such an element when the response gives it empty, unless it carries `ypy-preserve="false"`. A custom element that is already defined always keeps its children: only the attributes follow the response, unless the response marks it with `ypy-morph-force`.
morphThirdParty.markdownDescription: Selector of the elements a script other than YPY owns, besides every custom element. A morph keeps the children of such an element when the response gives it empty, unless it carries `ypy-preserve="false"`. A custom element that is already defined always keeps its children: only the attributes follow the response, unless the response marks it with `ypy-morph-force`.

multipart.description: Defaults of the ypy-multipart extension. A single request overrides them with `ypy-config='{"multipart":{...}}'`. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.
multipart.markdownDescription: Defaults of the ypy-multipart extension. A single request overrides them with `ypy-config='{"multipart":{...}}'`. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.

connectTimeout.description: Timeout of a connection attempt, in ms or as an interval string. `0` waits without limit. Defaults to `ypy.config.defaultTimeout`. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.
connectTimeout.markdownDescription: Timeout of a connection attempt, in ms or as an interval string. `0` waits without limit. Defaults to `ypy.config.defaultTimeout`. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.

pauseOnBackground.description: Close the connection while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-multipart:connect` and `false` otherwise. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.
pauseOnBackground.markdownDescription: Close the connection while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-multipart:connect` and `false` otherwise. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.

reconnect.description: Reconnect after the stream ends or fails. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-multipart:connect` and `false` for a stream opened by a request. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.
reconnect.markdownDescription: Reconnect after the stream ends or fails. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-multipart:connect` and `false` for a stream opened by a request. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.

reconnectDelay.description: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.
reconnectDelay.markdownDescription: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.

reconnectJitter.description: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.
reconnectJitter.markdownDescription: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.

reconnectMaxAttempts.description: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.
reconnectMaxAttempts.markdownDescription: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.

reconnectMaxDelay.description: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.
reconnectMaxDelay.markdownDescription: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string. Requires the `ypy-multipart` extension.

native.description: Defaults of the ypy-native extension. Requires the `ypy-native` extension.
native.markdownDescription: Defaults of the ypy-native extension. Requires the `ypy-native` extension.

path.description: The URL of the path configuration document, or `false` to not load it. The shell reads the same document. Requires the `ypy-native` extension.
path.markdownDescription: The URL of the path configuration document, or `false` to not load it. The shell reads the same document. Requires the `ypy-native` extension.

web.description: Outside the app, open the routes whose path configuration says `context: modal` as a layer (needs `ypy-layers`). Requires the `ypy-native` extension.
web.markdownDescription: Outside the app, open the routes whose path configuration says `context: modal` as a layer (needs `ypy-layers`). Requires the `ypy-native` extension.

nav.description: Settings of global boost and prefetch. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
nav.markdownDescription: Settings of global boost and prefetch. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

boost.description: Navigate every link and form of the page with a request and a swap, with no attribute. Off when `nonce` is set. A region turns it off with `ypy-boost="false"`. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
boost.markdownDescription: Navigate every link and form of the page with a request and a swap, with no attribute. Off when `nonce` is set. A region turns it off with `ypy-boost="false"`. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

confirmLeave.description: Show the browser's own leave-this-page dialog (`beforeunload`) while a form has changes no request has saved. A control is changed from its first `input` event until a request from it, or from its form, ends with a 2xx other than a GET, or the form is reset. A navigation that only swaps the page does not unload it, so the browser shows nothing then. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
confirmLeave.markdownDescription: Show the browser's own leave-this-page dialog (`beforeunload`) while a form has changes no request has saved. A control is changed from its first `input` event until a request from it, or from its form, ends with a 2xx other than a GET, or the form is reset. A navigation that only swaps the page does not unload it, so the browser shows nothing then. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

current.description: Mark the link to the current page with `aria-current="page"` and the class `ypy-current`, and renew the mark on every navigation. Set to `false` to turn it off. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
current.markdownDescription: Mark the link to the current page with `aria-current="page"` and the class `ypy-current`, and renew the mark on every navigation. Set to `false` to turn it off. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

prefetch.description: When a link the page navigates is requested ahead of the click. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
prefetch.markdownDescription: When a link the page navigates is requested ahead of the click. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

prefetchDelay.description: Milliseconds of hover, or of keyboard focus, before the prefetch starts. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
prefetchDelay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds of hover, or of keyboard focus, before the prefetch starts. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

prefetchMax.description: Prefetched responses alive at once; the oldest is dropped. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
prefetchMax.markdownDescription: Prefetched responses alive at once; the oldest is dropped. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

prefetchParallel.description: Prefetches in flight at once for the visibility mode. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
prefetchParallel.markdownDescription: Prefetches in flight at once for the visibility mode. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

prefetchTtl.description: Milliseconds an unused prefetched response is kept. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
prefetchTtl.markdownDescription: Milliseconds an unused prefetched response is kept. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

root.description: CSS selector of the root of the app. A boosted response that is a whole page (it has a doctype, `html` or `body`) and does not contain it is not swapped in: its URL is loaded as a plain page. Without it, the element with `ypy-history-elt` of the current page is the root, and a page that has none checks nothing. A response that ended on another origin is always loaded in full. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
root.markdownDescription: CSS selector of the root of the app. A boosted response that is a whole page (it has a doctype, `html` or `body`) and does not contain it is not swapped in: its URL is loaded as a plain page. Without it, the element with `ypy-history-elt` of the current page is the root, and a page that has none checks nothing. A response that ended on another origin is always loaded in full. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

settle.description: Milliseconds a navigation (a boosted request, or one that pushes a history entry) waits for the requests the form being edited still has in flight, after the field in focus was blurred so its `change` ran. `0` turns the blur and the wait off. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.
settle.markdownDescription: Milliseconds a navigation (a boosted request, or one that pushes a history entry) waits for the requests the form being edited still has in flight, after the field in focus was blurred so its `change` ran. `0` turns the blur and the wait off. Requires the `ypy-nav` extension.

noSwap.description: HTTP status codes for which YPY does not swap content.
noSwap.markdownDescription: HTTP status codes for which YPY does not swap content.

nonce.description: Requires the `ypy-csp` extension: until it has started, YPY processes no element and sends no request. The page also needs a script with a CSP nonce, and the `ypy` Trusted Types policy when the CSP enforces them. Requires the `ypy-csp` extension.
nonce.markdownDescription: Requires the `ypy-csp` extension: until it has started, YPY processes no element and sends no request. The page also needs a script with a CSP nonce, and the `ypy` Trusted Types policy when the CSP enforces them. Requires the `ypy-csp` extension.

poll.description: Default options of the smart polling for the whole page; the `ypy-poll` attribute overrides them per element. Requires the `ypy-poll` extension.
poll.markdownDescription: Default options of the smart polling for the whole page; the `ypy-poll` attribute overrides them per element. Requires the `ypy-poll` extension.

hidden.description: Factor applied to the interval of a poll while the tab is hidden, or `"pause"` to stop polling until the tab is shown. Requires the `ypy-poll` extension.
hidden.markdownDescription: Factor applied to the interval of a poll while the tab is hidden, or `"pause"` to stop polling until the tab is shown. Requires the `ypy-poll` extension.

min.description: Shortest interval a `YPY-Poll-Interval` header may set, in milliseconds or as `"100ms"`. Requires the `ypy-poll` extension.
min.markdownDescription: Shortest interval a `YPY-Poll-Interval` header may set, in milliseconds or as `"100ms"`. Requires the `ypy-poll` extension.

prefix.description: Adds one more attribute prefix. `ypy-` and `data-ypy-` always work. Set it in the `ypy-config` meta tag; changing it after load has no effect.
prefix.markdownDescription: Adds one more attribute prefix. `ypy-` and `data-ypy-` always work. Set it in the `ypy-config` meta tag; changing it after load has no effect.

preload.description: Options of the preload extension. Requires the `ypy-preload` extension.
preload.markdownDescription: Options of the preload extension. Requires the `ypy-preload` extension.

autoBoost.description: Preload boosted links without writing `ypy-preload`. Set `false` to turn that off. Requires the `ypy-preload` extension.
autoBoost.markdownDescription: Preload boosted links without writing `ypy-preload`. Set `false` to turn that off. Requires the `ypy-preload` extension.

boostEvent.description: Event that starts the automatic preload of boosted links and bare `ypy-preload` elements. `touchstart` always does too. Requires the `ypy-preload` extension.
boostEvent.markdownDescription: Event that starts the automatic preload of boosted links and bare `ypy-preload` elements. `touchstart` always does too. Requires the `ypy-preload` extension.

boostTimeout.description: How long a preloaded response stays valid for the automatic preload, in milliseconds or as `"5s"`. Requires the `ypy-preload` extension.
boostTimeout.markdownDescription: How long a preloaded response stays valid for the automatic preload, in milliseconds or as `"5s"`. Requires the `ypy-preload` extension.

progress.description: Settings of the progress bar. Requires the `ypy-progress` extension.
progress.markdownDescription: Settings of the progress bar. Requires the `ypy-progress` extension.

all.description: Show the bar for every request, not only navigations and elements with `ypy-progress`. Requires the `ypy-progress` extension.
all.markdownDescription: Show the bar for every request, not only navigations and elements with `ypy-progress`. Requires the `ypy-progress` extension.

delay.description: Milliseconds a request waits before the bar shows. Requires the `ypy-progress` extension.
delay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds a request waits before the bar shows. Requires the `ypy-progress` extension.

label.description: The accessible name of the bar. Requires the `ypy-progress` extension.
label.markdownDescription: The accessible name of the bar. Requires the `ypy-progress` extension.

retry.description: Default retry options for the whole page; the `ypy-retry` attribute overrides them per element. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
retry.markdownDescription: Default retry options for the whole page; the `ypy-retry` attribute overrides them per element. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

attempts.description: How many times a failed request is repeated. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
attempts.markdownDescription: How many times a failed request is repeated. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

backoff.description: Each wait is this many times longer than the one before. `1` keeps it constant. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
backoff.markdownDescription: Each wait is this many times longer than the one before. `1` keeps it constant. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

delay.description: Wait before the first repeat, in milliseconds or as `"1s"`. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
delay.markdownDescription: Wait before the first repeat, in milliseconds or as `"1s"`. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

jitter.description: How much each wait varies at random, as a fraction (`0.2`) or a percentage (`"20%"`), up and down. `0` keeps the waits exact. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
jitter.markdownDescription: How much each wait varies at random, as a fraction (`0.2`) or a percentage (`"20%"`), up and down. `0` keeps the waits exact. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

max.description: Longest wait between two attempts, in milliseconds or as `"30s"`. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
max.markdownDescription: Longest wait between two attempts, in milliseconds or as `"30s"`. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

methods.description: Methods that are repeated, a space or comma separated string or an array of upper-case names. It can only narrow the safe methods. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
methods.markdownDescription: Methods that are repeated, a space or comma separated string or an array of upper-case names. It can only narrow the safe methods. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

on.description: What counts as a failure: `network` (the request did not reach the server), `error` (also a 5xx answer), `always` (also a 4xx answer) or `never`. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
on.markdownDescription: What counts as a failure: `network` (the request did not reach the server), `error` (also a 5xx answer), `always` (also a 4xx answer) or `never`. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

unsafe.description: Repeat every method, including POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. The server may have run the first attempt. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.
unsafe.markdownDescription: Repeat every method, including POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. The server may have run the first attempt. Requires the `ypy-retry` extension.

safeEval.description: Replaces `Function` and `AsyncFunction` with nonce-based script injection, so `ypy-on`, `js:` values and `ypy-confirm` code run without `unsafe-eval` in the CSP. Needs `ypy-csp`. Requires the `ypy-csp` extension.
safeEval.markdownDescription: Replaces `Function` and `AsyncFunction` with nonce-based script injection, so `ypy-on`, `js:` values and `ypy-confirm` code run without `unsafe-eval` in the CSP. Needs `ypy-csp`. Requires the `ypy-csp` extension.

scripts.description: What happens to the `<script>` elements of a response: `auto` lets them run, `nonce` lets run only those with the nonce of the page (`inlineScriptNonce`, else the nonce of the first `<script nonce>`), `block` runs none. The scripts that do not run are taken out of the response. Any other value counts as `block`.
scripts.markdownDescription: What happens to the `<script>` elements of a response: `auto` lets them run, `nonce` lets run only those with the nonce of the page (`inlineScriptNonce`, else the nonce of the first `<script nonce>`), `block` runs none. The scripts that do not run are taken out of the response. Any other value counts as `block`.

signals.description: Settings of the signals extension. Requires the `ypy-signals` extension.
signals.markdownDescription: Settings of the signals extension. Requires the `ypy-signals` extension.

send.description: Send the signals in scope with every same-origin request, with no attribute. `ypy-signals-send="false"` turns it off for an element or a container (`:inherited`). Requires the `ypy-signals` extension.
send.markdownDescription: Send the signals in scope with every same-origin request, with no attribute. `ypy-signals-send="false"` turns it off for an element or a container (`:inherited`). Requires the `ypy-signals` extension.

sort.description: Settings of sortable lists. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.
sort.markdownDescription: Settings of sortable lists. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.

messages.description: What the live region says while a list is sorted with the keyboard: `grab`, `move`, `drop`, `cancel` and `revert`, each a text where `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. A message that is not set is not said. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.
messages.markdownDescription: What the live region says while a list is sorted with the keyboard: `grab`, `move`, `drop`, `cancel` and `revert`, each a text where `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. A message that is not set is not said. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.

cancel.description: What is said when a pick up is cancelled with Escape; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.
cancel.markdownDescription: What is said when a pick up is cancelled with Escape; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.

drop.description: What is said when an item is put down; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.
drop.markdownDescription: What is said when an item is put down; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.

grab.description: What is said when a list item is picked up; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.
grab.markdownDescription: What is said when a list item is picked up; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.

move.description: What is said when a picked up item is moved; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.
move.markdownDescription: What is said when a picked up item is moved; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.

revert.description: What is said when the list is put back after a refusal; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.
revert.markdownDescription: What is said when the list is put back after a refusal; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. Requires the `ypy-sort` extension.

sse.description: Defaults of the ypy-sse extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"sse":{...}}'`. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
sse.markdownDescription: Defaults of the ypy-sse extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"sse":{...}}'`. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

connectTimeout.description: Timeout of a connection attempt, in ms or as an interval string. `0` waits without limit. Defaults to `ypy.config.defaultTimeout`. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
connectTimeout.markdownDescription: Timeout of a connection attempt, in ms or as an interval string. `0` waits without limit. Defaults to `ypy.config.defaultTimeout`. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

heartbeat.description: Close the stream and open it again when no byte arrives for this long, in ms or as an interval string such as `45s`. A comment line (`: ping`) counts as a byte, so a server that pings keeps the stream alive. It catches a connection that a sleeping phone left open: it neither fails nor ends, so the retry would never run. Off by default (`0`). It reconnects only when `sse.reconnect` is on; otherwise the silent stream ends. When the page is shown again (`pageshow` from the back/forward cache, `online`, a tab that is visible again) a stream silent for longer than this is opened again at once, and a wait for the next attempt is skipped. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
heartbeat.markdownDescription: Close the stream and open it again when no byte arrives for this long, in ms or as an interval string such as `45s`. A comment line (`: ping`) counts as a byte, so a server that pings keeps the stream alive. It catches a connection that a sleeping phone left open: it neither fails nor ends, so the retry would never run. Off by default (`0`). It reconnects only when `sse.reconnect` is on; otherwise the silent stream ends. When the page is shown again (`pageshow` from the back/forward cache, `online`, a tab that is visible again) a stream silent for longer than this is opened again at once, and a wait for the next attempt is skipped. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

pauseOnBackground.description: Close the stream while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `false` otherwise. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
pauseOnBackground.markdownDescription: Close the stream while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `false` otherwise. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

reconnect.description: Reconnect after the stream ends or fails. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `false` for a stream opened by a request. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
reconnect.markdownDescription: Reconnect after the stream ends or fails. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `false` for a stream opened by a request. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

reconnectDelay.description: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`. A `retry:` field from the server replaces it. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
reconnectDelay.markdownDescription: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`. A `retry:` field from the server replaces it. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

reconnectJitter.description: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
reconnectJitter.markdownDescription: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

reconnectMaxAttempts.description: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
reconnectMaxAttempts.markdownDescription: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

reconnectMaxDelay.description: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
reconnectMaxDelay.markdownDescription: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

releaseOn.description: When the request gives back its queue slot and indicators: `immediate`, after the `first` swapped message, or at the `end` of the stream. The default is `immediate` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `end` otherwise. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.
releaseOn.markdownDescription: When the request gives back its queue slot and indicators: `immediate`, after the `first` swapped message, or at the `end` of the stream. The default is `immediate` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `end` otherwise. Requires the `ypy-sse` extension.

stream.description: Defaults of the ypy-stream extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"stream":{...}}'`. Requires the `ypy-stream` extension.
stream.markdownDescription: Defaults of the ypy-stream extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"stream":{...}}'`. Requires the `ypy-stream` extension.

frame.description: Apply the events of a stream one animation frame apart (at most 100 ms in a hidden tab), so a fast stream, such as the tokens of a model answer, costs one round of DOM work per frame. Off by default. Requires the `ypy-stream` extension.
frame.markdownDescription: Apply the events of a stream one animation frame apart (at most 100 ms in a hidden tab), so a fast stream, such as the tokens of a model answer, costs one round of DOM work per frame. Off by default. Requires the `ypy-stream` extension.

merge.description: Merge consecutive `ypy-patch-elements` events of the same mode (`inner`, `outer`, `append`) and selector that are waiting to be applied: the last `inner` or `outer` wins and `append` payloads join. The page ends the same. On by default. Requires the `ypy-stream` extension.
merge.markdownDescription: Merge consecutive `ypy-patch-elements` events of the same mode (`inner`, `outer`, `append`) and selector that are waiting to be applied: the last `inner` or `outer` wins and `append` payloads join. The page ends the same. On by default. Requires the `ypy-stream` extension.

pauseOnBackground.description: Close the connection while the tab is in the background and open it again, at once and with `Last-Event-ID`, when it is visible. Off by default. Requires the `ypy-stream` extension.
pauseOnBackground.markdownDescription: Close the connection while the tab is in the background and open it again, at once and with `Last-Event-ID`, when it is visible. Off by default. Requires the `ypy-stream` extension.

targetFallback.description: What happens when a target selector matches nothing: `true` falls back to the main target for a whole page or a response with a main, `"always"` also for a fragment, `false` never. Unset means on.
targetFallback.markdownDescription: What happens when a target selector matches nothing: `true` falls back to the main target for a whole page or a response with a main, `"always"` also for a fragment, `false` never. Unset means on.

test.description: Defaults of `ypy.idle()` (how long it waits, the quiet period). While work is pending `ypy-test` also writes `data-ypy-busy` on `<html>` and removes it when the work ends: the value lists the kinds of work, space separated (`request` in flight, `queued` in an `ypy-sync` queue, `swap` being inserted, `settle` settling). It is output for tests and styles, never something to write by hand. Requires the `ypy-test` extension.
test.markdownDescription: Defaults of `ypy.idle()` (how long it waits, the quiet period). While work is pending `ypy-test` also writes `data-ypy-busy` on `<html>` and removes it when the work ends: the value lists the kinds of work, space separated (`request` in flight, `queued` in an `ypy-sync` queue, `swap` being inserted, `settle` settling). It is output for tests and styles, never something to write by hand. Requires the `ypy-test` extension.

quiet.description: Milliseconds the page must stay without pending work before `ypy.idle()` resolves; content just swapped in may start the next request (a `load` trigger) in that time. `0` resolves at once. Requires the `ypy-test` extension.
quiet.markdownDescription: Milliseconds the page must stay without pending work before `ypy.idle()` resolves; content just swapped in may start the next request (a `load` trigger) in that time. `0` resolves at once. Requires the `ypy-test` extension.

timeout.description: Milliseconds `ypy.idle()` waits before it rejects with an error that names the work still pending. `0` waits for ever. A time such as `"2s"` also works. Requires the `ypy-test` extension.
timeout.markdownDescription: Milliseconds `ypy.idle()` waits before it rejects with an error that names the work still pending. `0` waits for ever. A time such as `"2s"` also works. Requires the `ypy-test` extension.

transitions.description: Uses the View Transitions API for swap animations.
transitions.markdownDescription: Uses the View Transitions API for swap animations.

validate.description: Settings of the field validation on the server. Requires the `ypy-validate` extension.
validate.markdownDescription: Settings of the field validation on the server. Requires the `ypy-validate` extension.

batch.description: The window, as a time, in which the fields of one form that ask the same URL go in a single request. Off by default; `ypy-validate-batch` overrides it per field, region or form. Requires the `ypy-validate` extension.
batch.markdownDescription: The window, as a time, in which the fields of one form that ask the same URL go in a single request. Off by default; `ypy-validate-batch` overrides it per field, region or form. Requires the `ypy-validate` extension.

ws.description: Defaults of the ypy-ws extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"ws":{...}}'`. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
ws.markdownDescription: Defaults of the ypy-ws extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"ws":{...}}'`. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

heartbeat.description: Close the socket and open it again when no message arrives for this long, in ms or as an interval string such as `45s`. The browser does not show protocol ping frames to the page, so the server has to send a message (any text) now and then. It catches a socket that a sleeping phone left open: it neither fails nor closes, so the reconnect would never run. The watch also covers a connection that never opens. Off by default (`0`). It reconnects only when `ws.reconnect` is on; otherwise the socket is closed. When the page is shown again (`pageshow` from the back/forward cache, `online`, a tab that is visible again) a socket silent for longer than this is opened again at once, a wait for the next attempt is skipped, and a socket that `pagehide` closed is opened again. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
heartbeat.markdownDescription: Close the socket and open it again when no message arrives for this long, in ms or as an interval string such as `45s`. The browser does not show protocol ping frames to the page, so the server has to send a message (any text) now and then. It catches a socket that a sleeping phone left open: it neither fails nor closes, so the reconnect would never run. The watch also covers a connection that never opens. Off by default (`0`). It reconnects only when `ws.reconnect` is on; otherwise the socket is closed. When the page is shown again (`pageshow` from the back/forward cache, `online`, a tab that is visible again) a socket silent for longer than this is opened again at once, a wait for the next attempt is skipped, and a socket that `pagehide` closed is opened again. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

maxOutgoingMessagesQueueSize.description: How many messages wait for the socket to open. A message sent when the queue is full fires `ypy:ws:error`. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
maxOutgoingMessagesQueueSize.markdownDescription: How many messages wait for the socket to open. A message sent when the queue is full fires `ypy:ws:error`. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

pauseOnBackground.description: Close the socket while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
pauseOnBackground.markdownDescription: Close the socket while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

protocols.description: Sub-protocols passed to the `WebSocket` constructor. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
protocols.markdownDescription: Sub-protocols passed to the `WebSocket` constructor. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

reconnect.description: Reconnect after the socket closes with one of `reconnectCodes`. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
reconnect.markdownDescription: Reconnect after the socket closes with one of `reconnectCodes`. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

reconnectCodes.description: Close codes that trigger a reconnect. Any other code ends the connection. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
reconnectCodes.markdownDescription: Close codes that trigger a reconnect. Any other code ends the connection. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

reconnectDelay.description: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
reconnectDelay.markdownDescription: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

reconnectJitter.description: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
reconnectJitter.markdownDescription: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

reconnectMaxAttempts.description: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
reconnectMaxAttempts.markdownDescription: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

reconnectMaxDelay.description: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.
reconnectMaxDelay.markdownDescription: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string. Requires the `ypy-ws` extension.

title: YPY configuration
